title: Set the screen up for tired eyes
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

It is late in the evening and the screen is hard to look at. Fix that, then find out how much room is left on the computer.

playgroundTask.goal: You set up the screen and checked your storage
playgroundTask.hint: Settings is split into sections down the left-hand side. The name of each section tells you what lives inside it — the one about text size is not the one about colour.

steps.say: Switch the screen to its dark colours.
Dim the screen for a dark room.
Find out how much space is left on this computer.

drDigitalSuccess: Bigger text, dark colours, a dimmer screen — and you know where to check your free space. Those four settings make a computer usable for hours instead of minutes.
drDigitalHint: Text size lives under Accessibility. Dark mode is under Appearance. Brightness is under Display. Free space has a section of its own.
